steps.source: function id<T:type>(x:T):T{return x;}type F=(x:string)=>string;const raw:any=[id];const outer:any={item:raw};const t:{item:[F,number=7]}=outer;String(t===outer)+"/"+t.item.length+"/"+t.item[1]+"/"+String(t.item[0]===id.<string>)+"/"+raw.length+"/"+String(raw[0]===id);

steps.source: function id<T:type>(x:T):T{return x;}type F=(x:string)=>string;let reads=0;let elementReads=0;const raw:any=[];Object.defineProperty(raw,"0",{get(){elementReads++;return id;}});const outer:any={get item(){reads++;return raw;},set item(v){this.saved=v;}};const t:{item:[F,number=7]}=outer;reads+"/"+elementReads+"/"+outer.saved.length+"/"+String(outer.saved[0]===id.<string>)+"/"+raw.length;

steps.source: function id<T:type>(x:T):T{return x;}type F=(x:string)=>string;function attempt(f:any){try{f();return "ok";}catch(e){return e.name;}}const raw:any=[id];let seen="";let saved:any;const outer:any={get item(){return raw;},set item(v){saved=v;seen=String(v[0]===id.<string>)+"/"+v[1]+"/"+attempt(()=>{v[0]=1;});}};const t:{item:[F,number=7]}=outer;seen+"/"+saved.length;

steps.source: function id<T:type>(x:T):T{return x;}type F=(x:string)=>string;function attempt(f:any){try{f();return "ok";}catch(e){return e.name;}}const raw:any=[id];let saved:any;const outer:any={get item(){return raw;},set item(v){saved=v;throw new RangeError("stop");}};const error=attempt(()=>{const t:{item:[F,number=7]}=outer;});error+"/"+saved[1]+"/"+attempt(()=>{saved[0]=1;})+"/"+String(raw[0]===id);

steps.source: function id<T:type>(x:T):T{return x;}type F=(x:string)=>string;function attempt(f:any){try{f();return "ok";}catch(e){return e.name;}}const first:any=[id];const second:any=[id];const outer:any={a:first,b:second};Object.defineProperty(outer,"b",{writable:false});const error=attempt(()=>{const t:{a:[F,number=7],b:[F,number=9]}=outer;});error+"/"+outer.a[1]+"/"+String(outer.b===second)+"/"+String(first[0]===id)+"/"+String(second[0]===id);
